objective: Start a Pokemon Emerald Nuzlocke. Obtain a starter and reach Oldale Town safely.
rules: Catch only the first eligible wild encounter per named area; eligibility begins after receiving Poke Balls.
Fainted Pokemon are permanently retired and must never be used again.
Do not reload to change an outcome. Stop if the entire usable party faints.
No duplicate or shiny exceptions are enabled in this run.
